text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm baaack!
That was a totally enjoyable race!
choice_data_list: Getting this result in a GⅠ is amazing!
Getting this result in a GⅠ is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, good smile!
I'm so happy to see you this pleased!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out, I'll make tons of people
happy with BIG races!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Your run in the NHK Mile Cup
was truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!!
I will definitely show you I can become number one in sprints!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If we aim for Umamusume of the Year,
we must first be selected for the URA Award's Sprint Division.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However... Even though the NHK Mile Cup
is a GⅠ, it is a Classic-class race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The sprint champion will be chosen from a pool
that includes seasoned Senior-class veterans.
We must consider how to proceed with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see!
Senior-tier Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I want to compete against the Senior Class too, YES!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The number one sprinter!
And the "Umamusume of the Year"!!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take on the seniors!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you're aiming for the Mile Championship,
the race that crowns the autumn mile king?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"The Mile Championship...!!
Oh, I'm getting so pumped up!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"However, the opponent is a Senior-class with abundant race experience.
Producing results like before will be extremely difficult."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
do you have any thoughts on that point?"

Just as Reporter Otonashi said, we need preparation
to compete on equal footing with the Senior Class.
So, in order to gain more experience—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"The Unicorn Stakes"!
Weeell, isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Um... that race is on dirt, though?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes!
That's right, that's right!!

However, from the perspective of gaining experience,
the conditions are all in place.

Besides, if it's Taiki Shuttle,
even if it's a dirt race—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem!!
I'll show you how I run!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll dash full speed ahead
down the path Trainer believes in!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: S-S-Splendid!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Fully prepared for the treacherous journey ahead,
she still charges forward, looking only straight ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Even if sand gets in my eyes and nose, or muddy water
splashes all over my head, I'll keep pushing the Umamusume forward!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To think you possess such resolve,
Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! Your sacrifice won't be
in vain, Trainer!
Not that we were actually talking about that, but with our eyes set on the big stage, we made entering the Unicorn Stakes our next goal.
